sons of दक्ष through वैरिणी who died in the attempt to get at the measurement of the earth by following their elder brothers.

--the second one thousand sons of असिक्नी and दक्ष. Advised by नारद they took to the path of ‘Not returning’, taken by their elder brothers; went to differ- ent parts of the world in search of their brothers, हर्यश्वस् and were lost. भा.

--the name of the Creator during ब्राह्म kalpa; possesses both vyakta and avyakta forms; two forms of spirit; the word and the supreme God; this is the inter- pretation of Manu, and also the Atharva Veda; the word is the Vedas as distinguished from and leading to Parabrah- man (Supreme). भा.
